dcterms:creator: Kiril Simov
Petya Osenova
dcterms:description: The BulTreeBank (BTB) dataset consists of 14,732 sentences from various genres, including newspaper articles, legal documents, and user-generated content. It is used for Named Entity Recognition and Part-of-Speech tagging tasks, with data split into training, development, and test sets.
dcterms:title: BulTreeBank (BTB)

dcterms:creator: Stefan Schweter
dcterms:description: The Universal Dependency version of BulTreeBank produced by Osenova and Simov, which includes 16 tags of the Universal POS tagset. The dataset is used for POS tagging tasks.
dcterms:title: Universal Dependencies - Bulgarian-BTB
